mission.title: Deadbolt
mission.description: Strike back at Zion and find the man who killed Morpheus.

npc.say: My husband is a pompous ass.

phase.briefing:
It seems that Lock's people are trying to keep a lid on the truth. They don't want their little secret getting out.
Some operatives are making a move against the Merovingian's assets. We need you to get in there and eliminate them. Here's the location.

enter.say: I don't think any of the Merovingian's forces are left. You'll have to take out the Zion operatives on your own.
I know, friend. I know. But you've got to pull yourself together. We've got a job to do.

objective.text: Kill all of the Zion operatives

done.say: That's the last of them. Time to get out of there.

phase.briefing: This kind of outright attack will not be tolerated! I am sending you to the nearest Zion base. You must eliminate them before they can mount another attack on our associates.

enter.say: All right, this is the spot. Take them all out, {player}.
What the hell are you doing here?!

objective.text: Kill all of the Zion operatives at the base

done.say: That's it. Better get out before any reinforcements show up.

phase.briefing:
While you were off playing around with your former friends from Zion, I've been busy searching for the man who was hired by Lock to kill Morpheus. And now, thanks to my hard work, he is found.
The Merovingian needs evidence of this homeless assassin's crime to bring Lock out of the shadows. I've tracked the killer to a hovel some distance from here. It is imperative that you travel to his location and talk to him.

enter.say: Okay, you're finally here. The bum's somewhere in this building. I don't know how they got in here, but they've managed it.
All ya see here is all I own in this world. You ain't never gonna take it from me without a fight!

done.say:
I, uh... you... you got somethin' about you, like... like...
Like the one wit' the FLIES! Ain't no way yer takin' me!
That's the one! See if you can get any information out of him...
Well, that was unfortunate. Before you leave, you must search his corpse. Maybe he's carrying something incriminating.
Magnificent. I am sure we can use that item. Now, your presence is desired elsewhere.

phase.briefing: The Merovingian has been informed of our progress and has come to this area to receive the evidence from you, personally. I do hope you understand the importance of this moment.

enter.say: The Merovingian doesn't venture out of his home very often. He must be excited about this evidence.

objective.text: Give the package to the Merovingian

talk.say: Truly passionate love is not so far from hate. I know that much.
My husband is a pompous ass.
Come, come. Give me the package.

done.say:
I have been waiting for this. Do you know what this package contains?
It is the porcelain mask which that... that homeless wretch wore as he killed Morpheus. Unbelievable. I am surprised that their Commander Lock would stoop to such measures.

mission.finish: You know, you probably wouldn't be getting such attention from the Merovingian if not for my mentoring of you. For that: you're welcome.
